name: dedupe-contacts
prompt: Add a generic helper uniqueBy(items, keyFn) to src/utils/array.js that returns the items with duplicate keys removed, keeping the first occurrence and the original order. Then use it in mergeContacts (src/contacts.js) so that merging two contact lists no longer produces duplicates: two contacts are the same person when their emails match after trimming and lowercasing. Contacts without an email are always kept.
